titleAr: اللوكيشن اللي العميل يبعته بيتحول لعنوان توصيل
titleEn: A shared location pin becomes the delivery address

en: The customer sent a location pin instead of an address

steps: In the address step of an order, the pin's own name or address text becomes the delivery address (shown back to the customer)
Anywhere else the agent asks what the customer needs and offers a new order (no model call, no credit)
edgeCases: A pin with no name or address: the customer is asked for one line of text, and the typed address completes the order
The coordinates stay on the Chat side only (the Store contract has no coordinates field), are never logged, and are erased with the customer
No reverse geocoding: nothing is sent to an outside service
gaps: The Store receives the address text only, not the coordinates (Store-side ask in docs/store-link.md)
